name: version-reuse-after-rollback
why: OPEN (not fixed; plan §9 kill -9 decision). A kill -9 of the owner rolls the database back to its last published generation (inside the RPO), so document _version numbers are issued again for different contents. A bank transfer computed before the crash (read at versions v, patch absolute balances with expect {version: v}) that is still in flight or retried with its request id after the restart passes its expect against the new, different document at the same version and writes stale balances: the bank no longer sums to 400 (398 here). Loss inside the RPO becomes silent corruption, not just loss. Shrunk from swarm seed 2761 to three kill/restart pairs of vm2.
